articles.title: Volunteers Turn Out for the Spring Cleanup Across Kettle Hill
articles.deck: Residents of Kettle Hill filled the hall on Monday to ask questions about the plan.
body: The group has raised $12,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.

articles.title: Letter: the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program Did a Good Job This Fall
body: To the editor: I have lived on Juniper Road for 15 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the March meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the stormwater drain repair in the budget. Many of us on Juniper Road use it every week.
Sadie Baptiste, Kettle Hill
